subject: Aurora Q3: flaglog & playbook — customer health, renewal risk, exec items
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Aurora Q3: flaglog & playbook — customer health, renewal risk, exec items

Team —

We have the Aurora QBR scheduled for Aug 18. I want to assemble a concise playbook for leadership: a one-page health snapshot, a renewal risk register (sorted by severity & mitigations), and 3 exec attention items we can surface in the meeting.

Please do the following by EOD today:
- Laura: short executive talking points (3) + any credit/discount history.
- Rishi: ARR/usage trends and headcount-impact bullets (if any) for the account.
- Marissa: populate the risk register with current mitigations and owner for each item; include SLA/incident history if relevant.
- Jonas: compile recent infra incidents (tickets + status) and any open escalation notes.

I've attached a starter "flaglog" spreadsheet (aurora-qbr-flaglog-v1.xlsx) with tabs for Health, Risks, and ExecNotes. Keep entries short — 1–2 bullets each. We'll consolidate into the QBR deck tomorrow.

Thanks,

Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Customer Success | Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.ai

Attachment: aurora-qbr-flaglog-v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aurora Q3: flaglog & playbook — customer health, renewal risk, exec items

On Wed, Aug 12, 2026 at 09:02 AM Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Team —
> 
> We have the Aurora QBR scheduled for Aug 18. I want to assemble a concise playbook for leadership...

Adding my inputs:
- Quick numbers: current ARR on platform: $1.24M (annualized as of Jul 31). Net new in Q2: +$45k (usage-driven).
- Utilization note: steady daily ingest but token growth concentrated in three heavy customers of theirs (impacts our latency masks).
- Renewal sensitivity: pricing negotiation likely; they asked procurement to re-evaluate third-party inference costs last week.

Ask: anyone with a recent invoice dispute or requested credit, flag here — I want all credit/exception history included in the RISK entry.

Rishi
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aurora Q3: flaglog & playbook — customer health, renewal risk, exec items

Attached is risk register v1 (aurora-risk-register-v1.xlsx). Highlights pasted below: 

Top risks (short):
1) Performance degradation on large retail peaks — Severity: HIGH — Impact: potential churn if not resolved before peak season; Mitigation: priority kernel tuning + reserved capacity during promotion windows; Owner: Jonas.
2) Pricing push from Procurement — Severity: MEDIUM-HIGH — Impact: renewal discount request; Mitigation: present unit-economics & Optimize recommendations; Owner: Rishi.
3) Data retention/compliance question — Severity: MEDIUM — Impact: delay in procurement signoff; Mitigation: provide SOC2 artifacts and retention options; Owner: Stephanie.
4) Integration lag with internal data pipeline — Severity: MEDIUM — Impact: partial feature degradation; Mitigation: support ticket + small tooling patch; Owner: Marissa.
5) Single-key caching hot-spot — Severity: LOW-MEDIUM — Impact: transient lat spikes; Mitigation: KV cache tuning + short-term workaround; Owner: Jonas.

I've filled the mitigation status column and added an "Open items" tab for outstanding asks.

Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachment: aurora-risk-register-v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aurora Q3: flaglog & playbook — customer health, renewal risk, exec items

Stephanie —

Adding the exec-facing items (to be pared to 3 bullets):
- Exec ask #1 (Revenue): Confirm runway vs renewals + proposed commercial path (upsell vs discount). Need finance to sign off on recommended concession bands.
- Exec ask #2 (Reliability): Quick statement on mitigations for peak-latency risk and a named fallback plan we can promise in QBR.
- Exec ask #3 (Strategic): Roadmap alignment ask: which product bets (prefetching/caching) reduce Aurora's unit costs — want a 2-slide recommendation.

Credit history: They requested a $25k one-time credit in May for a migration-related incident (we granted $10k). Please include that in the redline.

I'll draft the 3-slide "Exec talking points" doc and post it to the shared drive; will call out the delegation for QBR presenters.

Laura Bennett
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Morgan Pierce <morgan.pierce@auroraretail.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>, procurement@auroraretail.com
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 15:20:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Aurora Q3: flaglog & playbook — customer health, renewal risk, exec items

Stephanie —

Thanks for the heads-up. A couple of notes from Aurora's side ahead of the QBR: 
- We're seeing increased tail latency during promotional events (July 24 spike) — it's causing checkout timeouts and pushed our support volume up; we'll need more detail on proposed remediation and an ask from your execs on timeline.
- Procurement is preparing a pricing re-eval; they want our usage bands and a sample commercial concession to consider.

Would it be possible for your team to include a brief demo of the fallback path and a proposed concession band in the QBR? Otherwise procurement may request an interim pause on renewal conversations.

-Morgan
Director, Platform Engineering | Aurora Retail
morgan.pierce@auroraretail.com

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
To: Morgan Pierce <morgan.pierce@auroraretail.com>, procurement@auroraretail.com, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aurora Q3: flaglog & playbook — customer health, renewal risk, exec items

Morgan / team —

Appreciate the upfront context, Morgan. Quick summary of agreed next steps and owners before I consolidate the QBR packet: 
- Jonas: run the kernel tuning plan and produce a short timeline + rollback plan for peak-event mitigation by Fri COB. (Owner: jonas_weber)
- Marissa: finalize the risk register with the current mitigation ETA and add the July 24 incident note to the SLA section. (Owner: marissa_cole)
- Rishi + Laura: draft proposed commercial paths (recommended concession bands and upsell framing) and include finance sign-off notes. (Owners: rishi_malhotra, laura_bennett)
- Stephanie: compile deck, include 2 executive slides (reliability + commercial recommendation), and schedule the QBR for Aug 18 10:00 ET. Meeting link: https://meet.redwood.ai/stephanie/aurora-qbr-2026-08-14

Morgan — we'll include a 10-minute demo of the fallback flow and show the proposed concession band options. If procurement wants a pre-read, Marissa will send the risk register and the one-page health snapshot by EOD today.

Thanks everyone — I'll circulate a consolidated packet and the talking points for review morning of Aug 13.

Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Customer Success | Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.ai

Attachment: aurora-qbr-deck-draft.pptx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation)
